prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Redesign Adoption Certificate Card Layout: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a stage layout with clear visual confirmation during creation.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "body": "Your new desktop pet is almost ready to join your workspace."}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Adoption Certificate: Move sign_in to occur after pet adoption so users create their account after personalizing their pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [finish, new_screen] Add Desktop Controls Summary Screen: Add a new screen 'new_controls_summary' at the end of onboarding detailing pet interactions.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_controls_summary"], "home_intro": {"headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Here is a quick overview of how your desktop pet will interact on your screen."}}
3: [choose_path, new_flow] Guided Path Selection Story Flow: Rebuild the story and choose_path screens into a split narrative layout connecting intro lore directly to path choice.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll"}, "choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose How You Want to Meet Your Pet"}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Existing Account Pet Sync Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure returning users that signing in restores saved pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Restore Your Saved Pets", "body": "Log into your account to keep your custom pets synced and safely backed up."}}
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Photo Quality Guidance Hint: Add photo upload requirements hint to explain proper lighting and framing for photo pet creation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload clear, well-lit front photos for best pet creation results."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Progress Notification Toggle: Add a progress bar and background notification toggle on the waiting screen while the pet generates.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Preparing Your Pet Desktop Companion"}}
7: [adoption, incentive] Pick Friend Personality Trait Badges: Add mascot badges highlighting companion personality traits on the pick_friend selection screen.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"headline": "Select Your Ideal Companion", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Special Companion Traits Included", "style": "playful"}]}}
8: [choose_path, layout] Two-Column Path Choice Layout: Switch path selection screen to a two-column layout comparing custom pet creation and instant adoption side-by-side.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Select Your Onboarding Route"}}
9: [finish, notification] Desktop Pet Spawn Launcher Confirmation: Add desktop spawn troubleshooting hints and launch button to the finish screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "If your pet doesn't appear on your desktop immediately, click 'Summon Pet' from your desktop tray menu.", "button_label": "Launch Pet on Desktop"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate layout while retaining its title and purpose is allowed under rule 4.
Moving sign-in to occur after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed by rule 4.
Adding a new screen after home_intro is allowed under rule 4.
Redesigning story and choose_path into a split scroll layout is permitted under rule 4.
Updating sign-in copy to explain pet sync does not break any rules.
Adding guidance hints to the photo upload screen is allowed.
Adding progress and notification toggles to the waiting screen complies with onboarding rules.
Adding trait badges to pet selection options is permitted inside onboarding.
Two-column layout comparing custom pet creation and adoption maintains the choose_path functionality.
Adding desktop launcher confirmation hints to home_intro is permitted.
